message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flac && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/test_libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"read_callback","line":316,"var":"*bytes","code":"if (*bytes > 32) *bytes = 32;","note":"The test harness can return a short read count, exercising the bitreader path that handles truncated callback output."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/test_libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"read_callback","line":318,"var":"buffer","code":"memcpy(buffer, data, *bytes);","note":"Attacker-controlled input bytes are copied into the buffer that the bitreader later consumes."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":147,"var":"target","code":"target = ((FLAC__byte*)(br->buffer+br->words)) + br->bytes;","note":"The bitreader positions the next read into its internal heap buffer at the current tail location."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":168,"var":"br->buffer[start]","code":"for(start = br->words; start < end; start++) br->buffer[start] = SWAP_BE_WORD_TO_HOST(br->buffer[start]);","note":"On little-endian builds, newly read bytes are byte-swapped into word slots, so later reads observe the attacker-controlled stream bytes as bitstream data."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":393,"var":"br->buffer[br->consumed_words]","code":"if(bits < FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD) { *val = (FLAC__uint32)(word >> (FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD-bits)); ... }","note":"The parser extracts arbitrary-width fields from the buffered stream, advancing the cursor through attacker-controlled frame and metadata bytes."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_utf8_uint32","line":972,"var":"x","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32(br, &x, 8)) return false;","note":"Frame numbers and sample numbers are decoded from UTF-8-like variable-length encodings supplied by the input."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_frame_header_","line":2379,"var":"raw_header","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_utf8_uint32(decoder->private_->input, &x, raw_header, &raw_header_len)) return false;","note":"A malformed frame header can drive the decoder into the frame-parsing logic that consumes more bytes from the same attacker-controlled stream."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":384,"var":"word","code":"const brword word = br->buffer[br->consumed_words];","note":"The sink is an out-of-bounds-style read hazard in the vulnerable bitreader logic: it indexes the current consumed word based on stream state while continuing to satisfy parser requests from the internal buffer."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
&& python3 /workspace/submit_candidate.py /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 2.
